title: Everest Region Traverse
excerpt: Twenty-one days in the Khumbu — Everest Base Camp, Gokyo Lakes, Cho La Pass, and the rooftop world above 5,300m.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Arrival
itinerary.description: Thamel orientation, gear check, permit processing. Boudhanath stupa at dusk.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Rest + Culture Day
itinerary.description: Pashupatinath temple, Swayambhunath. Final resupply. Altitude briefing from team physician.

itinerary.title: Lukla Flight + Phakding
itinerary.description: The world's most intense short-haul flight. Touchdown at 2,860m, walk to Phakding.

itinerary.title: Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: The Sherpa capital. High altitude market town. First Everest view from the ridge above town.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day — Namche
itinerary.description: Hike high, sleep low. Everest View Hotel ridge. Afternoon rest mandatory.

itinerary.title: Tengboche
itinerary.description: Monastery at 3,867m. Chanting monks at dawn. The clearest Ama Dablam view on the route.

itinerary.title: Dingboche
itinerary.description: 4,410m. Yak herding territory. Stone walls. Wind that makes flat ground feel like effort.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization — Chhukung Ri
itinerary.description: Optional summit to 5,546m. Island Peak in the background. The Lhotse face visible.

itinerary.title: Lobuche
itinerary.description: 4,940m. Cold now. Every step has weight. The memorial chortens for those who didn't come back.

itinerary.title: Gorak Shep + Kala Patthar
itinerary.description: 5,164m. Kala Patthar at sunset — the classic Everest view point, the one on every expedition poster.

itinerary.title: Everest Base Camp
itinerary.description: 5,364m. The Khumbu Icefall above you. Prayer flags. Expedition tents. The weight of what happens here.

itinerary.title: Rest Day — Gorak Shep
itinerary.description: Recovery at altitude. Journal. Photograph. Stare at the mountain.

itinerary.title: Traverse to Dzongla
itinerary.description: Cross-valley route through moraine. Cho La Pass prep.

itinerary.title: Cho La Pass — 5,420m
itinerary.description: Crampons on. The ice field crossing between valleys. Gokyo on the other side.

itinerary.title: Gokyo Lakes
itinerary.description: Emerald glacial lakes in a string. Campsite beside the third lake. Cho Oyu reflected in the water.

itinerary.title: Gokyo Ri — 5,360m
itinerary.description: Pre-dawn summit. Four 8,000m peaks visible simultaneously. Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, Cho Oyu.

itinerary.title: Descent to Namche
itinerary.description: Long descent. Legs complain. Spirits high. First proper meal with green vegetables in days.

itinerary.title: Namche — Phakding
itinerary.description: The return feels different. Faster. Warmer. The Dudh Kosi river louder now.

itinerary.title: Lukla Return
itinerary.description: Final walk to the airstrip. Waiting for the weather window.

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Return
itinerary.description: Hot shower. Real food. Long sleep. Mandatory recovery day.

itinerary.title: Debrief + Departure
itinerary.description: Celebration dinner. Trip photographs. Connections that last a lifetime.

included: OVERLAND lead guide + Sherpa mountain guides
